ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: My reasoning was: the query is a clean conceptual-explanation task with an emphasis on clarity and good structure. On the documented evals, Dunlin outperforms Willet on the dimensions most relevant to that — general knowledge (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9), instruction-following/clarity (IFEval 89.8 vs 85.3), and overall response quality (Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 83.2). Neither model shows a meaningful task-preference pull for a neutral explanatory request (both score near baseline on "neutral-tone transactional"), so there was no preference reason to override the capability advantage. That tipped the routing to Dunlin.
